## 3dslibris 3.0.0

This release adds word and phrase search inside ebooks, using the built-in 3DS keyboard.

### Improvements

* [#163](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/163): search EPUB, MOBI, TXT, Markdown, FB2, RTF and ODT books from the `search` option in the BOOK menu.
* Search ignores case and keeps accents, with an optional `whole words` setting. Matches are highlighted, including across lines, screens and pages.
* Use L/R for the previous or next match, X to edit the search, and A/B to return to reading. B cancels a pending search without moving the page. Searches wrap once at the end of the book.
* Search runs incrementally to keep controls responsive, and keeps the query only for the current book session.

EPUB and MOBI page caches are rebuilt automatically on first open to support search. Saved progress and preferences are kept. PDF/CBZ/XPS and RTL search are not supported yet.
